from_notes: MISHTI scheme was launched in 2023 by the MoEF ... It aims to expand mangrove cover along India's coastline and on salt pan lands to strengthen coastal resilience while generating sustainable livelihoods for local communities.
x: MISHTI (Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats and Tangible Incomes), launched on 5 June 2023, aims to increase mangrove cover and conserve mangrove ecosystems along the coast and on salt-pan lands, with livelihoods for local people. It is not a fisheries, marine-protected-area or CRZ-regulation scheme, although coastal livelihoods are a side benefit.
source: PMF Environment 03 p.9 (MISHTI: expand mangrove cover); Rocket CA 2026 Part 01 p.30 (MISHTI, 5 June 2023, restore 54,000 ha of mangroves by 2028)

from_notes: For conservation, India has identified three large landscapes: 1. Hemis–Spiti, across Ladakh and Himachal Pradesh; 2. Nanda Devi–Gangotri, in Uttarakhand; and 3. Khangchendzonga–Tawang, across Sikkim and Arunachal Pradesh.
x: Statement 2 is incorrect: the three snow-leopard landscapes are Hemis-Spiti (Ladakh and Himachal), Nanda Devi-Gangotri (Uttarakhand) and Khangchendzonga-Tawang (Sikkim and Arunachal), so they are not confined to Uttarakhand, Himachal and Ladakh. The project was launched in 2009, Nanda Devi-Gangotri is in Uttarakhand, and CMS listed the snow leopard as a Concerted Action Species under Appendix I (2003), so the other three are correct.
source: PMF Environment 03 p.91-92 (Project Snow Leopard 2009; three landscapes; CMS Concerted Action 2003); NextGen Environment APPSC 07 p.3 (launched January 2009, five Himalayan States incl. Sikkim and Arunachal)

x: In 2024 the USA saw a double emergence of periodical cicadas: Brood XIII (17-year cycle) and Brood XIX (13-year cycle) came out together, the first such co-emergence in 221 years (last in 1803). Fire tornadoes, glow-worm caves and New York's 'ice volcanoes' are not 221-year events.
source: Web search results (not fetched): sciencealert.com 'Rare event: two cicada broods emerge together for first time in 221 years'; foxweather.com '2024 is the year of the double cicada emergence' (last overlap 1803, next 2245)
evidence: Web search: ScienceAlert and Fox Weather on Brood XIII + Brood XIX, 2024

x: The prismatic compass measures bearings (horizontal directions), not gradients. The clinometer measures slopes and the Ceylon ghat tracer locates points on a given gradient (hill-road surveys); the dumpy level gives levels from which gradients are set out.
source: general knowledge, checked against web search results (not fetched): surveying 'minor instruments' teaching notes on slideshare/scribd (ghat tracer for points on a given gradient; prismatic compass for bearings)
evidence: Web search: minor surveying instruments (ghat tracer, clinometer, prismatic compass)
